cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my opening and I'll call our argument settled. Mum can stop hearing about it over lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. I'll hand it over beside my paintings. You needn't make a speech; just be there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sunday works. Hanging gets us speaking again. Help take them down after the exhibition and I'll give Mum something else to hear about.
